Problem Statement:
Given a string S convert each characters of the string into ASCII values and print the sum of the numbers. 
Input Description:
The input consists of a string S with a maximum length of 100000 characters. 
Output Description:
The output is a single integer representing the sum of the ASCII values of all characters in the input string. 
Sample Input:
guvi 
Sample Output:
443
